title: Gender Biases and Where to Find Them: Exploring Gender Bias in Pre-Trained Transformer-based Language Models Using Movement Pruning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the Sentence Encoder Association Test (SEAT) to measure differential cosine similarity between embeddings of gendered attributes and stereotyped targets, and the StereoSet Stereotype Score (SS) on the gender subset to measure the percentage of examples where the model prefers a stereotypical association over an anti-stereotypical one.
